answer_2.quote: We employ Natural Language Inference (NLI) to determine the semantic relationship between the origin claim and the corresponding correct evidence... We also compute similarity using Sentence-Transformer embeddings, measure Perplexity with GPT2-XL, calculate N-gram overlap, and use BERTScore for text similarity validation.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three Computer Science annotators with expertise in natural language processing (NLP) to manually evaluate the quality of misinformation text in MISBENCH. The annotators were provided with 500 pairs of generated instances... They were tasked with two main evaluations: Entailment Check and Conflict Check.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to assess whether the generated misinformation logically supports the claim (Entailment) and whether it contradicts the correct evidence (Conflict).
